svg.text: Verification flow (as implemented in tb/test.sv and the Questa runs)
One simulation per SPI_MODE value. Inside a run, the initial block repeats reset → generate → transact → check.
1. Test configuration
spi_test_top parameters: SPI_MODE ∈ {0,1,2,3} (one run each), CLKS_PER_HALF_BIT=5, MAX_BYTES_PER_CS=5, CS_INACTIVE_CLKS=10
2. Reset — reset()
i_Rst_L low for 2 i_Clk cycles, all DUT inputs idled, 10-cycle settle
3. Generate transaction — value_generation()
tx_count = rx_count = $urandom_range(1, MAX_BYTES_PER_CS); tx_byte[$], rx_byte[$] random 0..255; cb.i_TX_Count ← tx_count
4. Drive DUT + slave response — test(): TX_THREAD, MISO_THREAD
send_byte() per TX byte (o_TX_Ready / i_TX_DV handshake); send_miso() per RX byte, edge-aligned to o_SPI_Clk
5. SPI transfer (DUT)
CS_n low for all tx_count bytes; 16 SCLK edges per byte; MOSI shifted out, MISO captured simultaneously
6. Monitor activity — MOSI_MON_THREAD, RX_MON_THREAD
check_mosi(): 8 o_SPI_MOSI samples on o_SPI_Clk edges; check_rx(): o_RX_Byte at each posedge o_RX_DV
7. Compare expected vs actual
MOSI: observed === tx_byte[j]; RX: o_RX_Byte === rx_byte[i] (or rx_byte[i]−1, see known issues)
8. Record result
match → $display("PASS: …"); mismatch → $error("FAIL: …") (counted as an error by the simulator)
9. Return to idle
wait o_TX_Ready === 1 and o_SPI_CS_n === 1, then CS_INACTIVE_CLKS cycles; print "TEST n COMPLETE"
10. Coverage / report
after $finish: coverage report -details; coverage save spi_cov_modeN.ucdb; the four UCDBs are viewed together in the Questa Coverage Report
repeat (N): N = 200 in the code listing; the recorded runs show 5 iterations
Note: "ALL TESTS COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY" is printed unconditionally after the loop. Pass/fail is decided by the PASS/FAIL lines and the simulator error count.
